title: Fixed-sector globalization is not a cutoff-uniform completion theorem

uniformity_audit.bounded_generator_step: K1397 converts covariant to ordinary low norms using ||Q_N||<=N, so its restart constant is explicitly cutoff dependent
uniformity_audit.energy_sequence: K1371 supplies smooth neutral data with bounded K1366 energy but Gauss density unbounded in H^-1 as charge and spatial frequency rise together
uniformity_audit.local_completion: K1392 removes cutoff dependence on one common interval only by assuming one additional completed triangular tier
uniformity_audit.iteration_gap: No conserved or uniformly bounded completed triangular low norm has been constructed for arbitrary large data, so the local cutoff convergence cannot yet be iterated to every time
uniformity_audit.logical_effect: The current energy-only fixed-sector globalization route is not cutoff uniform. This is a route boundary, not a counterexample to existence of a different global completed flow
uniformity_audit.reopeners: A cutoff-uniform low triangular bound, modified conserved energy, resonant normal form, summable hierarchy or another invariant controlling the K1371 concentration reopens global completion
uniformity_audit.boundary: N-dependent global existence for every cutoff and local convergence for the completed flow do not commute automatically with N to infinity and T to infinity
